csbgen.name: ROGUE

value.name: FRONT_REAR_DEPTH
value.doc: Perform front and rear clipping and generate depth clamped primitive.

enum.name: CMPMODE
enum.doc: Compare mode used in performing depth/stencil tests.

enum.name: CULLMODE
enum.doc: Selects the back face culling mode.

enum.name: FLATSHADE
enum.doc: Indicates which vertex to use as the source when flat shading.

enum.name: GS_OUTPUT_TOPOLOGY
enum.doc: Specifies the output primitive topology from the Geometry Shader.

value.name: REPLACE
value.doc: Replaces stencil buffer value with Stencil Ref Value.

value.name: INCREMENT_SATURATE
value.doc: Increments stencil buffer value and saturates at 0xFF.

value.name: DECREMENT_SATURATE
value.doc: Decrements stencil buffer value and saturates at 0x00.

value.name: INCREMENT
value.doc: Increments stencil buffer value. Overflows from 0xFF to 0x00.

value.name: DECREMENT
value.doc: Decrements stencil buffer values. Underflows from 0x00 to 0xFF.

field.name: validid
field.doc: For opaque and translucent objects, this value is compared against the value supplied in a global register. If smaller, the HW will treat the object as though ISP_TAGWRITEDISABLE is set. Punch through, fast punch through and depth feedback objects are left unchanged.

field.name: upass
field.doc: User pass spawn control.

field.name: tagwritedisable
field.doc: If set, the object is not forwarded to the TSP for texturing and shading. This can be used for an object which only updates depth and stencil buffers.

field.name: ovgmtestdisable
field.doc: If set, the OVG mask test is disabled.

field.name: two_sided
field.doc: If set, two-sided stencil testing is enabled.

field.name: bpres
field.doc: If set, ISP State Word B is present.

field.name: dbenable
field.doc: If set, depth bias is enabled.

field.name: scenable
field.doc: If set, scissor coordinates are enabled.

field.name: vistest
field.doc: Occlusion queries are enabled when set to 1.

field.name: visbool
field.doc: Occlusion query type is a simple Boolean rather than an accumulated value. Enabled by ISP_VISTEST.

field.name: visreg
field.doc: Index pointing to the occlusion query counter to be incremented. Enabled by ISP_VISTEST.

field.name: ovgvispassmaskop
field.doc: Maskplane operation for use when OVG mask test is disabled.

field.name: maskval
field.doc: Maskplane data value for use with maskplane pass types when OVG mask test is disabled.

field.name: dwritedisable
field.doc: When set, the depth test occurs as normal but the depth buffer is not updated.

field.name: dfbztestenable
field.doc: When set, the up-front depth test is enabled for DFB pass type.

field.name: linefilllastpixel
field.doc: If set, the last pixel of a line is filled.

field.name: pointlinewidth
field.doc: The width/pitch used for rendering lines, point-filled and line-filled triangles.

field.name: sref
field.doc: Stencil reference value for this object used in the stencil comparison.

field.name: scmpmask
field.doc: Mask of bits used in stencil buffer compare. The current stencil buffer value is bitwise ANDed with this value before the stencil test is performed.

field.name: swmask
field.doc: This is a per bit write enable mask. After the stencil operation has been performed on the stencil buffer, the result is bitwise ANDed with this field before being written back.

field.name: left
field.doc: Left edge of the clip region, in 32 pixel units.

field.name: right
field.doc: Right edge of the clip region, in 32 pixel units.

field.name: top
field.doc: Top edge of the clip region, in 32 pixel units.

field.name: bottom
field.doc: Bottom edge of the clip region, in 32 pixel units.

field.name: dbindex
field.doc: Depth Bias Index.

field.name: scindex
field.doc: Scissor Index.

field.name: vtxsize
field.doc: Specifies the size of the vertex in DWords, including all DWords not output to the rasterisation phase.

field.name: tsp_unclamped_z_pres
field.doc: If set, an unclamped Z value is written out at the start of the TSP data immediately after the RHW (where present).

field.name: render_tgt_pres
field.doc: If set, render target is present, this is always assumed to be the last thing in the vertex.

field.name: vpt_tgt_pres
field.doc: If set, viewport target is present, this is assumed to be the last thing in the vertex except render target if present.

field.name: psprite_size_pres
field.doc: If set, the sprite size register in the USC output registers is valid, this is always assumed to be the last thing in the vertex except render target and viewport target if present.

field.name: isp_position_depth_clamp_z
field.doc: If set, the Z value written into the ISP vertex data is depth clamped.

field.name: rhw_pres
field.doc: If set, the W value is written to memory. W is always present and valid in the UVS. This bit should be set unless the object is of type viewport.

field.name: cullplane7
field.doc: If set, User Plane 7 is a cull distance and should not be clipped against.

field.name: cullplane6
field.doc: If set, User Plane 6 is a cull distance and should not be clipped against.

field.name: cullplane5
field.doc: If set, User Plane 5 is a cull distance and should not be clipped against.

field.name: cullplane4
field.doc: If set, User Plane 4 is a cull distance and should not be clipped against.

field.name: cullplane3
field.doc: If set, User Plane 3 is a cull distance and should not be clipped against.

field.name: cullplane2
field.doc: If set, User Plane 2 is a cull distance and should not be clipped against.

field.name: cullplane1
field.doc: If set, User Plane 1 is a cull distance and should not be clipped against.

field.name: cullplane0
field.doc: If set, User Plane 0 is a cull distance and should not be clipped against.

field.name: plane7
field.doc: If set, clipping result of P.V for Plane 7 is present.

field.name: plane6
field.doc: If set, clipping result of P.V for Plane 6 is present.

field.name: plane5
field.doc: If set, clipping result of P.V for Plane 5 is present.

field.name: plane4
field.doc: If set, clipping result of P.V for Plane 4 is present.

field.name: plane3
field.doc: If set, clipping result of P.V for Plane 3 is present.

field.name: plane2
field.doc: If set, clipping result of P.V for Plane 2 is present.

field.name: plane1
field.doc: If set, clipping result of P.V for Plane 1 is present.

field.name: plane0
field.doc: If set, clipping result of P.V for Plane 0 is present.

field.name: f32_npc
field.doc: A count of the number of DWords in the USC output registers assumed to be output from the TA as non-perspective correct interpolated 32-bit floating point values.

field.name: f32_flat
field.doc: A count of the number of DWords in the USC output registers assumed to be output from the TA as flat-shaded 32-bit floating point values. The value output is taken from the vertex specified by TA_FLAT_SHADE_VTX.

field.name: f32_linear
field.doc: A count of the number of DWords in the USC output registers assumed to be output from the TA as linearly interpolated 32-bit floating point values.

field.name: f16_npc
field.doc: A count of the number of DWords in the USC output registers assumed to be output from the TA as non-perspective correct interpolated 16-bit floating point values.

field.name: f16_flat
field.doc: A count of the number of DWords in the USC output registers assumed to be output from the TA as flat-shaded 16-bit floating point values. The value output is taken from the vertex specified by TA_FLAT_SHADE_VTX.

field.name: f16_linear
field.doc: A count of the number of DWords in the USC output registers assumed to be output from the TA as linearly interpolated 16-bit floating point values.

field.name: output_clip_planes
field.doc: Specifies the number of the User Plane values to be written out to the rasterisation phase (only the first N planes will be output). When this value is configured as zero (the default) then the User Clip Planes will be used solely for Clipping and the results will not be available inside the pixel shader.

field.name: clip_right
field.doc: Right edge of the clip region in 32 pixel units.

field.name: clip_top
field.doc: Top edge of the clip region in 32 pixel units.

field.name: clip_bottom
field.doc: Bottom edge of the clip region in 32 pixel units.

field.name: clip_left
field.doc: Left edge of the clip region, in 32 pixel units.

field.name: render_target
field.doc: The render target to terminate.

field.name: stream3_size
field.doc: A count of the number of DWords in the USC output registers assumed to be streamed out to memory from the TA. The DWord count starts at the end of Stream2 after the end of VTXSIZE+STREAM1_SIZE+STREAM2_SIZE DWords.

field.name: stream2_size
field.doc: A count of the number of DWords in the USC output registers assumed to be streamed out to memory from the TA. The DWord count starts at the end of Stream1 after the end of VTXSIZE+STREAM1_SIZE DWords.

field.name: stream1_size
field.doc: A count of the number of DWords in the USC output registers assumed to be streamed out to memory from the TA. The DWord count starts at the end of the current vertex after the end of VTXSIZE DWords.

field.name: stream0_mem_output
field.doc: Controls whether Stream0, as defined by VTXSIZE, should be streamed out to memory.

field.name: stream0_ta_output
field.doc: Controls whether Stream0, as defined by VTXSIZE, should be processed by the TA and written into primitive blocks.

field.name: sync
field.doc: Indicates that a state update stream program should be issued.

field.name: pds_data_size
field.doc: The number of constants to load in 16 byte chunks.

field.name: pds_temp_size
field.doc: The number of temporaries to allocate in 16 byte chunks.

field.name: pds_data_addr
field.doc: The PDS data address 4GB range, 16-byte granularity.

struct.name: STATE_PDS_SHADERBASE
struct.doc: The pixel shader base is the base address of the PDS Data Segment. The code segment is address is PDS_PIXEL_SHADERBASE + PDS_PIXELSHADERSIZE. The pixel shader program issues the DOUTU for the Fragment Shader only.

struct.name: STATE_PDS_TEXUNICODEBASE
struct.doc: This is the PDS Code Address used for 2 programs. The Program which issues the DMAs (DOUTD etc.) for uniform data and/or texture state.

struct.name: STATE_PDS_VARYINGBASE
struct.doc: This is the base address of the PDS Data Segment. The code segment is address is PDS_VARYINGBASE + PDS_VARYINGSIZE.

struct.name: STATE_PDS_TEXTUREDATABASE
struct.doc: This points to the DMAs to load the Texture State (or contains the State with DOUTW commands).

struct.name: STATE_PDS_UNIFORMDATABASE
struct.doc: This points to the DMAs to load the Uniforms (or contains the Uniforms with DOUTW commands).

struct.name: STATE_PDS_SIZEINFO1
struct.doc: If any of the size fields are 0, then that program will not be run. PDS_PIXELSHADERSIZE is always 2 128-bit Words.

field.name: pds_tempsize
field.doc: 0 = 16 128-bit words, 1 = 1 128-bit word.

struct.name: STATE_PDS_SIZEINFO2
struct.doc: If any of the size fields are 0, then that program will not be run.

field.name: pds_tri_merge_disable
field.doc: Disable triangle merging.

field.name: prim_msaa
field.doc: When set, per-primitive MSAA is enabled.

field.name: pres_prim_id
field.doc: When set, per-primitive ID is present.

field.name: drawclippededges
field.doc: Defines whether edges created by the clipper are drawn or not.

field.name: pretransform
field.doc: If set, clipping and viewport transform are disabled, as the data from the USC is treated as being in screen space.

field.name: wclampen
field.doc: If set, the W value going into the view port transform is clamped to the WCLAMP value.

field.name: wbuffen
field.doc: Selects W Buffering mode during view port transform.

field.name: resetbbox
field.doc: Reset primitive max bounding box reported in registers ROGUE_CR_TE_RGNBBOX_X and ROGUE_CR_TE_RGNBBOX_Y at start of this primitive.

field.name: updatebbox
field.doc: If set, primitive max bounding box registers (ROGUE_CR_TE_RGNBBOX_X and ROGUE_CR_TE_RGNBBOX_Y) and updated for these primitives.

field.name: cullmode
field.doc: 00 = no culling, 01 = cull clockwise, 10 = cull counter clockwise.
